details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4333-4350 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The failure notification uses `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` to assume the editor completed and attribute the failure to a downstream step, but that signal only proves a summary comment was posted.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted the flag can be set by a fallback summary after editor failure, so the message can misattribute the root cause; severity is the highest reported and reviewers disagreed only on whether the issue is primarily correctness or misleading documentation.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4340-4360 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The heredoc body for the failure comment is indented, so the literal leading spaces become part of the posted Markdown and break the intended formatting.
  WHY: All reviewers agreeing on this issue said the body will render with unwanted indentation or as a code block; one reviewer also claimed a shell parse error, so the merged finding keeps the shared formatting defect without adopting the stronger claim.
- agents.md:543-570 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documentation overstates what `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` guarantees, implying it means the editor completed rather than only that the summary comment was posted.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently said the doc misleads maintainers about the signal’s semantics; severity stays medium because the issue is documentation accuracy rather than runtime behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4327 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The step defines a local `gh_retry` fallback instead of consistently using the shared helper.
  WHY: Only one reviewer treated this as a real issue and assigned low confidence; the others either dismissed it or only mentioned it as a hardening suggestion.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4334 (comment) and logic around 4330-4362 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The failure comment assumes `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` means the editor succeeded, but it only means a summary comment was posted.
  WHY: If the editor fails but posts a fallback summary successfully, the workflow will incorrectly attribute the failure to downstream steps rather than the editor.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4336-4350 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Heredoc indentation spaces become part of the comment body.
  WHY: The GitHub comment will render with incorrect formatting (indented as code).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4334 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Comment says "we know the editor completed" but signal only proves comment was posted.
  WHY: Misleading documentation for maintainers.
- agents.md:540-570 (section 20.3) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Documentation states or implies `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` means editor finished work.
  WHY: Misleads maintainers about the signal’s actual meaning.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4340-4352 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc used to define the failure comment body `BODY` is indented with 10 spaces.
  WHY: In Markdown, a line starting with 4 or more spaces is rendered as an indented code block. Since the entire comment is indented in the YAML file, it will be posted to GitHub as a single preformatted block, breaking links and formatting.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4337 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code comment and the following failure message claim that "The editor stage completed".
  WHY: The signal `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` only indicates that a summary comment was successfully posted. This can happen even if the editor stage failed or was partially completed, as the `Post editor summary comment` step has a fallback mechanism that generates a dummy summary if the actual editor summary file is missing or empty.
- agents.md:554, 560 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documentation overstates the meaning of `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true`.
  WHY: It claims the signal means "the editor finished its work" or "the editor completed", while it only guarantees that the summary comment is visible on the PR. This can cause maintainers to misinterpret the signal’s reliability for diagnosing editor-level failures.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:43xx (heredoc bodies around lines 4336-4349 and 4352-4360) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc content is indented with 10 spaces to align with YAML structure, and those literal spaces become part of the GitHub comment body.
  WHY: The leading spaces before the comment text will render the entire comment as an indented code block in GitHub Markdown, breaking the intended formatting.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4334-4335 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment states that when `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` "we know the editor completed," but that is inaccurate.
  WHY: The signal only confirms a summary comment was successfully posted to the PR thread, not that the editor completed successfully.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4338-4339 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The posted failure message claims "The editor stage completed" when the signal only proves a summary was posted.
  WHY: The message can incorrectly attribute the failure to downstream steps when the editor actually failed but a fallback summary was posted.
- agents.md:546-548 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documentation describes the signal as confirming "the editor finished its work" rather than only confirming the summary comment was posted.
  WHY: The documentation conflates a posted summary with editor success, which can mislead maintainers.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4333-4334 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment claims that `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` proves the editor completed successfully, but this signal is set whenever the comment POST succeeds, even when the comment contains a fallback summary from an editor failure.
  WHY: When the editor fails but the fallback summary successfully posts, `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED` becomes true and the failure-notification step can incorrectly blame downstream steps instead of the editor.
- agents.md:543 (new section 20.3) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documentation duplicates the same overclaim as the workflow comment, stating that `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` proves editor completion.
  WHY: Future maintainers relying on this documentation may make the same incorrect assumption about signal semantics and misattribute editor failures.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4341-4350 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The literal spaces at the beginning of the heredoc lines become part of the `BODY` content because the heredoc uses `<<EOF` rather than `<<-EOF`.
  WHY: The failure comment may render with unexpected indentation or as a code block, harming readability of the PR comment output.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4327 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: This step defines a local fallback `gh_retry` instead of using the shared helper from `gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: The local fallback does not implement the retry/backoff logic, logging, or rate-limit handling that the shared helper provides, so API calls in the failure path may be less resilient.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml ~4340-4359 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The failure notification uses `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` to decide that "the editor stage completed" and the failure was downstream.
  WHY: The flag is set whenever the summary comment POSTs successfully, even if the editor itself failed and the summary is a fallback, so the message can misattribute the root cause.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml ~4332-4335 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline workflow comment overstates what the signal guarantees.
  WHY: It conflates "the summary comment was posted" with "the editor succeeded," so the comment should reflect the actual invariant.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml 4341-4350 (if-branch) and 4352-4360 (else-branch) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The heredoc delimiter `EOF` is indented with spaces and the body lines also carry leading spaces.
  WHY: This produces a heredoc parse error and, even ignoring that, the Markdown would render with unwanted indentation or as a code block.
- agents.md section 20.3 (added by PR) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rationale implies the editor always finishes its work before the downstream failure.
  WHY: The editor may fail and a fallback summary may still be posted, so the description should clarify that the signal only confirms the summary comment was posted.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml ~4327 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The step defines a local `gh_retry` function instead of consistently using the shared helper from `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: This bypasses standardized logging and backoff, though the reviewer noted it was a minor hygiene concern.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
